prompt: Which change follows from this sample’s marks?
promptZh: 依這件樣品的痕跡，應做哪項調整？

options.text: Bring the side pads closer but leave the end pads alone.
options.zh: 把側邊墊塊往內移近，兩端墊塊不變。
options.whyZh: 痕跡朝端板，應調整兩端，不是側邊。

options.text: Bring the end pads closer and keep the side pads in place.
options.zh: 把兩端墊塊往內移近，側邊墊塊維持原位。
options.whyZh: 痕跡指向縱向移動，所以兩端墊塊往內移，側邊不動。

options.text: Move both kinds of pads farther apart.
options.zh: 把兩種墊塊都移得更遠。
options.whyZh: 講者只要縮小端板墊塊的間距，側邊維持原位。

options.text: Leave the pads unchanged and check only the sound again.
options.zh: 墊塊不變，只再聽一次聲音。
options.whyZh: 聲音本身不能判斷方向，這次痕跡已有足夠線索調整兩端。

explanationZh: 痕跡指向縱向移動，所以兩端墊塊往內移，側邊不動。
evidence: A mark running toward an end panel points to movement along the length of the carton. | This sample has marks toward an end panel. For the next test, narrow the gap only between the pads on that pair of panels.

vocabulary.note: 此處指箱體縱向兩端的板面，而非左右側板。
